IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Taylor, Overstreet, Shea, Scott, Condotta, Haler, Buys, Rodne, Pike, Magendanz, and Vick

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating an exemption in the state environmental policy act for transportation projects in jurisdictions with comprehensive plans that were subject to an environmental analysis prior to adoption.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating an exemption in the state environmentalpolicy act for transportation projects in jurisdictions withcomprehensive plans that were subject to an environmental analysisprior to adoption; and adding a new section to chapter 43.21C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Transportation projects delineated in programs required under RCW36.81.121, 35.77.010, or 35.58.2795 in counties and cities withcomprehensive plans adopted under chapter 36.70A, 36.70, 35.63, or35A.63 RCW that were, prior to adoption, subject to environmentalanalysis through an environmental impact statement under RCW43.21C.030(2)(c) are exempt from compliance with this chapter.
